title: situation.confederate_opening.title
railroad: the Confederate seat opens the war (0040): on a relief attempt at Sumter, a landing at Pickens, or, failing both, the day Anderson's provisions run out (15 April)

gate.none: the order to fire on a fort, the labelled railroad of 0040; why the states seceded is narrated under cause-of-secession, not here

citations.at: I-1 p. 297: Walker authorizes the demand and, if refused, reduction on 10 April (day 36); pp. 301-302: the further telegrams of 11 April. https://ehistory.osu.edu/books/official-records/001/0297. [I] the option opens from the dated authorization, after this situation has its relief or landing cause, rather than waiting four days from that cause
